summary: InflaRx N.V. filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) to register up to $65,000,000 of ordinary shares for an at-the-market (ATM) offering through Leerink Partners under an existing sales agreement dated June 28, 2024. Sales will be made on Nasdaq under symbol IFRX, with Leerink receiving up to 3.0% commission. This is a routine securities offering, not a special situation. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other special-situation categories. The offering is a standard capital raise with no unusual structural features. What to watch is potential dilution from ATM sales; no risk-arb angle applies.
